common: Photorealistic editorial food and interior photography for a premium casual steak and lobster house at night. Low-key warm lighting, single soft spotlight upper left, deep shadows, 3000K. Black marble faint white veins, deep forest green walls #14281F, burgundy leather, dark walnut wood, brushed gold cutlery and brass, glowing charcoal. Shallow depth of field, 50–85mm lens, fine film grain, natural rich color and glistening meat juices. No text, logos, signage, watermarks or recognizable faces. Not illustration or 3D.
